context:
This is a rename operation, not an extraction. Move directories, update
imports, update tests. No new packages, no compatibility shims.
description:
Five subsystems live under `benchbox/core/` but are not in the supported
benchmark registry, have no CLI integration, and are not exported from the
main `benchbox` module:

| Subsystem          | Path                          | External Consumers |
|--------------------|-------------------------------|--------------------|
| NL2SQL             | benchbox/core/nl2sql/         | Zero               |
| AIML Functions     | benchbox/core/aiml_functions/ | Zero               |
| Multi-Region       | benchbox/core/multiregion/    | Zero               |
| GPU Infrastructure | benchbox/core/gpu/            | cudf.py (1)        |
| Concurrency        | benchbox/core/concurrency/    | Zero               |

Their placement under `core/` makes them look productized. Move them under
`benchbox/experimental/` so the namespace signals their status.

GPU is the only coupling wrinkle: `benchbox/platforms/cudf.py` imports from
`benchbox.core.gpu`, so that import must be updated to
`benchbox.experimental.gpu`.

anti_patterns.dont: add experimental modules to the public registry to avoid the move

anti_patterns.why: a namespace move within the repo is sufficient
the goal is isolation, not removal

preserves.behavior: All experimental subsystems remain importable via benchbox.experimental.*
Supported benchmark registry and CLI behavior unchanged
cudf.py platform adapter continues to work via updated import path

verifications.description: Supported benchmark API and registry tests still pass
Public exports reflect only supported surfaces
No experimental subsystem imports remain under benchbox/core/

verifications.command: uv run -- python -c 'from benchbox.experimental import nl2sql, aiml_functions, multiregion, gpu, concurrency'
verifications.description: Experimental modules are importable from the new namespace

work_units.notes:
mkdir -p benchbox/experimental/
git mv benchbox/core/{nl2sql,aiml_functions,multiregion,gpu,concurrency} benchbox/experimental/
Add benchbox/experimental/__init__.py with a docstring marking this as
experimental, unsupported code.
work_units.summary: Create benchbox/experimental/ and move the 5 subsystem directories

work_units.notes:

- Each subsystem's internal imports
- benchbox/platforms/cudf.py (the only external consumer)
Verify with: grep -r 'from benchbox.core.\(nl2sql\|aiml_functions\|multiregion\|gpu\|concurrency\)' benchbox/
work_units.summary: Update all internal imports across the 5 subsystems and cudf.py

work_units.notes:
Update tests/unit/core/{nl2sql,aiml_functions,gpu,multiregion}/ imports
to reference the new experimental paths.
